He talks up his dedication to upholding the rule of law while bowing to the pressures of global discussions on human rights—which we all know is just code for progressive interference trying to dismantle our traditional values and national sovereignty. 

He wants everyone to applaud because he reminds us, “I took an oath to uphold [...]” but an oath means nothing if you are letting foreign globalist agendas dictate how our society governs itself. Instead of standing firm on time-tested moral boundaries and family values, they hide behind legalistic jargon and international consensus. If we lose our cultural ethos to this modern progressive drift, we lose the very foundation of our nation. We need real leadership, personal responsibility, and a return to authority, not more compliance with globalist noise.

Folks, take a good look at the nonsense the establishment is trying to push on us. President John Mahama comes out here giving us this high-flown talk, claiming that foundational policies are linked to legal frameworks, cultural ethos, and collective societal agreement. It is pure distraction, skirting around the real issues of moral clarity and duty. He talks up his dedication to upholding the rule of law, but let’s be honest, he is just bowing to the pressures of global discussions on human rights—which is nothing more than code for progressive interference trying to dismantle our traditional values and national sovereignty. 

He expects us to clap just because he reminds us, “I took an oath to uphold [...]” but an oath means nothing when leaders cave to foreign globalist agendas and let them dictate how our society governs itself. Instead of standing firm on time-tested moral boundaries and family values, they hide behind legalistic jargon and international consensus. If we let this modern progressive drift wash away our cultural ethos, we lose the very foundation of our nation. We need real leadership, personal responsibility, and a return to authority, not more compliance with globalist noise.
